resources.string: Your saved data can\'t be unlocked

Fasting Shift encrypts your data with a key kept in this phone\'s secure hardware. That key was reset, which can happen after a security change such as removing or changing the screen lock, or restoring the phone. Without the key, the data saved on this phone can\'t be read by anyone, including us.
Start fresh deletes the unreadable data so you can keep using the app.
If you exported a backup file, you can restore it afterwards in Settings.
The data on this phone can\'t be recovered without its key. The app will restart empty.
